verdict.rationale: Forter's own Salesforce Commerce Cloud extension lets merchants set decision preferences that run actions automatically, such as capturing payment and placing the order when Auto Invoice is YES after a Forter decision. The MCP docs also mention AI-driven policy updates. This is a fixed set of toggles plus a thin policy mention, not a documented general rule builder. Webhooks only send event notifications, so they are adjacent rather than user-defined rules. Missing for 10: a documented user-defined rule engine with event-to-action conditions, coverage beyond the single extension, details on what policy updates can trigger, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
